description: Result of the latest finished crawl audit of the property's own site (HTML only, no JavaScript): audit date, pages crawled, the plan's per-audit page limit and whether the crawl was cut by it, two health scores (0–100) with the formula written out (page health: share of crawled pages with no error; traffic health: share of Search Console impressions of the last 28 days that land on pages with no error), pages counted per severity (error, warning, notice), issues sorted by impressions of the affected pages (code, severity, title, fix, pages, impressions, clicks), site-wide issues (robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt, AI bots) and the health trend over the previous audits. Without a finished audit it states the state of the last one and points to request_site_audit. Use it for "how healthy is the site" or "what should I fix first"; get_audit_issue lists the pages of one issue. / Última auditoria concluída do site: nota por páginas e por tráfego com a fórmula, problemas por impressões afetadas, problemas do site inteiro e tendência.

language.description: Language of issue titles and fixes (default en).

limit.description: Issues listed (default 30), ordered by impressions of the affected pages.

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. The value "demo" selects a demonstration site with fictional data: it works without signing in and is read-only. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id; "demo" é um site de demonstração com dados fictícios, sem login e só leitura.

name: get_site_audit
title: Site audit
